# Baseline — 2026-08-04, five fixture briefs

`grok-3-mini` on every stage, `grok-3-mini-critic` for both critics and the judge.
Generated by `scripts/run_evals.py --fixtures`, all eight pages each.

The scorecards here are from the **second** judging pass. Read the variance note
below before comparing anything against these numbers.

## Computed metrics (these are reproducible)

| book | openers | q_end | words/pg | beats/pg |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| eagle-planet | 0.875 | 0.000 | 18.5 | 0.875 |
| moon-fox | 1.000 | 0.000 | 17.8 | 0.750 |
| seed-garden | 0.750 | **0.875** | 18.8 | 0.750 |
| submarine | 0.625 | 0.125 | 25.5 | 0.750 |
| teddy-bear | **0.375** | 0.000 | **13.4** | 0.875 |

## Judge variance, measured — the caveat that matters

The same five books were judged twice, same model, `temperature 0.0`. The scores
moved:

| book | delight | showing | momentum |
|---|---|---|---|
| eagle-planet | 0.625 → 0.500 | 0.875 | 1.000 |
| moon-fox | 0.625 | 0.875 | 0.875 |
| seed-garden | 1.000 | 0.250 | 1.000 |
| submarine | 0.875 → 0.625 | 0.750 → 1.000 | 0.875 |
| teddy-bear | 0.375 → 0.250 | 0.500 | 0.875 → 0.500 |

`delight` moved on three of five books, by up to 0.25 -- two pages of an
eight-page book. So **a judged difference below ~0.25 is not evidence of anything**,
and the judged half cannot presently detect a change smaller than its own noise.
The computed metrics have no such problem: they are arithmetic and reproduce exactly.

## Recital columns are empty here, and that is a defect of this run

All five books show `-` for `fact_recital_beats` and `fact_recital_prose`, because
`generate_and_score` passed `notes=[]` -- the pipeline returns an outline, not its
grounding. Fixed after this run via the `on_task_result` capture callback, and unit
tested, but **not yet exercised by a fixture run**. The next baseline should show
numbers in those columns; if it does not, the fix did not work.
